quarterly_data.quarter: Tower Semiconductor press release: NewPhotonics and Tower Semiconductor Begin High-Volume (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tower Semiconductor and NewPhotonics (a fabless photonic IC company) announced high-volume shipment of NewPhotonics' laser-integrated, serviceable optical-engine PICs built on Tower's PH18DA silicon photonics platform (heterogeneously integrated InP: monolithic lasers, SOAs, modulators and photodetectors on one PIC). The shipping volume-production PICs support 800G to 1.6T for FRO/LRO/LPO and XPO pluggable transceivers and NPO socket-pluggable applications; the NPG102 PICs for 800G and 1.6T use 200G-per-lane designs, and the CPX-MSA compliant NPC505 chipsets for 6.4T NPO will begin volume shipment in 1H27. Tower's Ed Preisler (VP and GM, RF Business Unit) called NewPhotonics the first to bring heterogeneous laser-integrated optical engines on PH18DA into high-volume production (a company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: NPG102 PICs (800G and 1.6T, 200G-per-lane) in high-volume shipment; NPC505 6.4T chipsets volume shipment in 1H27
